title: orania palindan var. sibuyanensis
intro: Orania palindan var. sibuyanensis, commonly known as the Sibuyan Orania, is a species of flowering plant in the family Pterocarpaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in the Philippines to treat various health conditions. The Sibuyan Orania has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing fever, treating wounds, and preventing infections. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
